# Version 5 Change Log

Version 5 responds directly to the Version 3 visual-review findings.

## Layout

- Removed the repetitive bottom-left table/card layout.
- Introduced vertical evidence timelines, capability rails, circular learning loops and diagonal progress paths.
- Increased visual connection between each diagram and the spoken argument.

## Right-side visuals

- Ten slides retain relevant Mars or engineering imagery.
- Ten slides now use native editable infographics.
- Infographics explicitly show research, engineering, surfaced issues and completion.

## Content depth

- Explains how agents search, analyze, critique and document in controlled parallel workflows.
- Defines structured work-product contracts and machine-readable evidence links.
- Shows engineering converting uncertainty into bounded research requests.
- Shows the research harness returning evidence into the same engineering baseline.
- Connects traceability and automated issue detection to faster review-gate completion.

## Preserved constraints

- Twenty slides.
- Exactly thirty minutes.
- Mars Society 2026 audience.
- Mars-first, practical engineering framing.
- Human-directed autonomy and verification by design.
- Illustrative case-study values remain clearly disclosed.

## Restored Version 1 content

- Recovered the original non-software engineering scope across aerospace, mechanical, electrical, controls, manufacturing and process disciplines.
- Restored the complete definition of a harness as workflow, tools, skills, memory, work-product contracts, validation and gates.
- Restored Hypatia’s Generate → Validate → Critique → Repair → Approve → Persist loop and the rule that only approved outputs flow forward.
- Restored Intelligent Engineer’s phase-specific workspaces, phase locking, critical-design sprints, multidisciplinary analysis, DFMA/FMEA and controlled next-phase seeds.
- Restored adaptive human/AI responsibility boundaries, model and vendor independence, persistent enterprise memory and the wider Hyperia/VIB/PM Accelerator ecosystem.
- Restored the full research → engineering → research request → evidence return → engineering completion → verification → operations learning loop.
- Added `13_Detailed_Initial_Chat_Summary_and_Restored_Concepts.md` as the durable design record.

## September 2026 — “The AI Path to Mars” integration

- Reframed the opening around the distinction between knowledge and execution.
- Defined the model as the source of intelligence and the harness as the source of mission capability.
- Expanded the harness definition to include orchestration, instructions, tools, context, memory, specialist agents, validation and approval.
- Replaced the two-harness overview on slide 5 with a five-stage Discover → Engineer → Verify → Deliver → Evolve sequence.
- Standardized epistemic status as Observed, Derived, Assumed and Unknown while keeping provenance separate.
- Added ground-truth gates and explicit human approval for consequential actions.
- Expanded mission memory to preserve provenance, configuration state, decisions, dissent and lessons learned.
- Added high-power propulsion and complex program coordination to the physical-system scope.
- Replaced the slide 15 placeholder evidence categories with verified NASA/JPL MOXIE results and an explicit feasibility-versus-scale warning.
- Recast slides 16–17 around continuous duty cycle, solid-oxide stack life, dust, maintenance and redundancy.
- Replaced the slide 18 product ecosystem with eight platform-neutral skill blueprints.
- Revised the close to: model equals intelligence; harness equals mission capability.
- Added a source-integration record and portable-skill catalog to the documentation.
